data.gender_notes: Osama is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is alive, the living one, the doer. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Osama usually hope their child will grow to embody living man and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Osama belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Living man.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Osama total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: عثامة
in_arabic.meaning: اسماء الذى اشتق من عسم و معناه الاسد القوى الشديد
in_arabic.long_meaning: عثامة هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'عسم' الذى يحمل معنى الاسد القوى الشديد. و يعتبر من الاسماء العربية القديمة التى تطلق على الذكور و تحمل دلالات القوة و الشجاعة فى الثقافة الاسلامية و العربية.

in_urdu.name: عثامہ
in_urdu.meaning: عثامہ کا مطلب ہے مضبوط اور طاقتور شخص
in_urdu.long_meaning: عثامہ ایک عربی نام ہے جو 'عسم' کے جذر سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے مضبوط اور طاقتور۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے اور مسلمانوں میں شائع ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیا میں۔

in_hindi.name: उसामा
in_hindi.meaning: उसामा का अर्थ है शक्तिशाली और बलवान व्यक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: उसामा एक अरबी नाम है जो 'उस्म' के मूल से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है शक्तिशाली और बलवान। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण है और भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में प्रचलित है।

in_pashto.name: عثامہ

in_english.name: Osama
in_english.long_meaning: Osama is an Arabic name derived from the root 'عسم' (ʿ-s-m), meaning strong, powerful, and fierce lion. It has significant historical and spiritual connotations in Islamic tradition, symbolizing courage and strength. The name Osama is widely used across Muslim cultures and is associated with positive personality traits such as bravery and resilience.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Osama" is most commonly associated with Osama bin Laden, the late leader of Al-Qaeda, an Islamic extremist group responsible for various terrorist attacks around the world. Bin Laden's actions and the terrorism associated with his name have had a profound impact on global culture. The name became synonymous with terror and evil, leading many to avoid or shun individuals with the same name, even if they had no connection to bin Laden or his actions.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, the name "Osama" holds a positive spiritual significance. It is a name that evokes a sense of life and vitality, as it means "the living one" or "the doer." In this context, the name is a reminder of the importance of living a meaningful and purposeful life, and of striving to do good deeds and make a positive impact on the world. It is a name that inspires hope and determination, and encourages individuals to be active agents in their own lives and in the lives of others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Living man" symbolizes The one who is alive, the living one, the doer. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Osama serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of living man.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Arabian tribesman and companion of the Prophet Muhammad The name Osama carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Osama ibn Zayd was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad and the first governor of Medina.
